_note: Raw materials: gathered (resources/crafting/nodes.json) and worked at stations. value is in pennies (Inventory: 12 pennies a mark, 20 marks a crown).

items.name: Iron ore
items.description: Rust-red rock from Greystone's levels. Wants a forge to be any use.

items.name: Steel bar
items.description: A short bar of good steel, folded and quenched. Blades and gate-bands are made from these.

items.name: Wood
items.description: Split lengths of ash and oak, dry enough to work or burn.

items.name: Hide
items.description: A scraped hide, salted against rot. Tanned, it makes jerkins and straps.

items.name: Flax
items.description: Retted flax stalks, ready for the loom or for bowstrings.

items.name: Cloth
items.description: A length of plain linen. Padding, bandages, sacks.

items.name: Charcoal
items.description: Black, light and hot-burning. A forge eats it by the sack.

items.name: Fever-root
items.description: A knuckled root from the Darkwood. Steeped, it quiets the Grey Fever. It does not cure it.

items.name: White salt
items.description: Salt as white as frost, from Greystone's deep vein. Rare, and not what the miners are paid to dig.
